criterion: Prefill = artpipe validator/facts PASS, which ranks technical validity (alpha, canvas, facing presence) — it cannot rank whether the thing looks right for the biome. Your eye rules.

RM_Boilhide.note: Add some deadly color on those boils. Too little color here. Maybe a dangerous violet tinged with yellow?

RM_Grimewing.note: Darken it and make its skin more pink. Make its knees bent forward like a mammal, to add alien nature.

RM_Gristleswarm.note: Looks ok, but East facing has only four legs, while North and South have six. Make the strange flesh between the plates sickly white.

RM_Middenbeetle.note: This beast is capable of stealing. Needs a new name to deconflict Middenshell. How about a Gripper? Always carrying something.

RM_Middenshell.note: Your color palette is too uniform per biome. Needs more variety. Please make this a huge tubeworm-like creature with scaled tentacles, a long irregular shell made of accreted minerals fused into debris and bezoars. Truly large. Will lash out a tentacle at objects and pull them towards itself, seeming to "eat" them. Doors. Walls. Anything. Cannot pull off Gravplating or walls of a ship, but it can pull off any normal object sitting outside the ship not inherently "gravship" items.

RM_Scumrat.note: Too terran. Make it more alien. How about a Scumslider? An oozing beast like a slug with two tails that it uses to lurch forward. Three eyes on stalks watching in all directions with eyes that are a cross between silly googly eyes and a horror-film's stare.

RM_Slagmole.note: Too much of this green stone in the back of otherwise terrestrial animals. Give this fella a face like a shovel and keep the digging front claws. Then make its back covered in rib-like structures.

RM_Sloghog.note: Too terran. Make it more alien.
